components.css: .ds-note {font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);} .ds-notes-title {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.85rem;width:fit-content;} .ds-notes-title h1 {margin:0;font-size:2.75rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.035em;} .ds-spark {width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--accent);transform:rotate(12deg);transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-notes-title:hover .ds-spark {transform:rotate(57deg);} .ds-note p {max-width:55ch;margin:1rem 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem;line-height:1.8;} .ds-tools {display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem 1.5rem;margin-top:1.5rem;} .ds-tools a {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;color:inherit;font-size:.9rem;text-underline-offset:.25em;text-decoration-color:var(--muted);} .ds-tools a:hover {text-decoration-color:var(--ink);} .ds-count {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:30px;padding:.2rem .7rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;} @media(max-width:580px){.ds-notes-title h1{font-size:2.35rem;}.ds-spark{width:26px;height:26px;}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-spark{transition:none;}.ds-notes-title:hover .ds-spark{transform:rotate(12deg);}} .ds-note a:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview:
Present the person's name, role, experience, projects, skills, and contact information with calm typography and factual language. This documents the implemented Astro portfolio and the user's explicit portfolio direction: "remove all fancy taglines" and "build a subtle portfolio website."

The blog presents compact personal notes using the same DM Sans and neutral themes as the portfolio. Its modest headings, rounded tag links, small blue geometric asterisk, and inline author initials supply the user-requested minimal playfulness. Homepage previews retain the portfolio section rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Shared neutral light and dark themes with restrained blue accents.
Flat sections, thin dividers, and modest rounded controls.
A large transparent portrait with a vivid animated coral, pink, violet, and teal gradient; this remains the portfolio's only playful area; the blog allows small, restrained accents.

rules.name: The Factual Copy Rule
rules.body: Use factual names, roles, section headings, descriptions, and action labels only. Do not add taglines, slogans, metaphors, motivational claims, or clever promotional headings. The hero heading is the person's name.

rules.name: The Theme Pairing Rule
rules.body: Resolve colors through the existing theme variables. Keep text, controls, borders, and interaction states legible in both themes.

dos: Do use the person's name, actual role, factual section headings, and explicit action labels.
Do preserve each surface's light and dark theme pairings and visible keyboard focus.
Do use DM Sans throughout writing pages and homepage previews, with uniform article prose and modest headings.
Do keep blog playfulness to the small geometric accent, rounded tag links, and factual initials.
Do use the same neutral themes and shared chrome throughout the site.
Do keep the centered shell, responsive stacking, readable line lengths, and simple portrait treatment.
donts: Don't add fancy taglines, slogans, metaphors, promotional headings, or invented claims.
Don't reintroduce marquees, stickers, oversized monograms, grain, rotated panels, or decorative gradients outside the approved portrait background.
Don't replace factual project and experience content with marketing copy.
